name: THE JUDGES
note: One of the three judges of the Liar's Assay (doc 03 Part One; errata 73 B: 'the judges and the pencil are Room 4's'). Seated behind the long table, out of the lamp's pool (doc 05: the lamp 'leaves the judges dark'). Cut from room-04's composition master by subtraction against its plate (tools/art/room04-judges.py), so he is registered to the plate by construction. Present while the Assay sits: from B3 until Duel Two is won (errata 76 B). No tree: doc 54's TALK TO and USE are the room's (peopleResponses); every other verb is doc 07's people pool.
walkToNote: On the floor in front of the table, facing it: the judges sit behind it and are spoken to across it.
barksNote: Doc 07 writes no barks for the judges.

sprite.note: Frame 0 at rest; frame 1 a breath (everything above the table top lifted 1 px, tools/rig/ambient-breath.py's rule with the table as the hem). Beats every 5, 7 and 4.5 s across the three, so they drift apart and never move together (ruling 20; Tyler: no person in a room is ever static).
